# Priceline
> Priceline is an online travel booking platform for discounted hotels, flights, rental cars, vacation packages, and trip management.

Priceline helps travelers compare prices, book travel products, and access special savings such as hotel deals, flight discounts, rental car offers, and bundled vacation packages.

## Core Booking
- [Priceline Home](https://www.priceline.com/): Main entry point for searching hotels, flights, rental cars, and vacation packages.
- [Hotels](https://www.priceline.com/hotels): Search hotel rooms, compare rates, and book discounted stays.
- [Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights): Search airfare, compare flight options, and book airline tickets.
- [Rental Cars](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars): Compare rental car prices and reserve vehicles from major providers.
- [Vacation Packages](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages): Bundle flights and hotels into package deals for additional savings.
- [Cruises](https://www.priceline.com/cruise): Browse cruise options and compare itineraries and pricing.

## Hotel Deals
- [Hotel Deals](https://www.priceline.com/hotel-deals): Explore discounted hotel offers across destinations and travel dates.
- [Express Deals Hotels](https://www.priceline.com/hotel-deals/express-deals): Find opaque hotel discounts with lower published prices.
- [Hotels in United States](https://www.priceline.com/hotel-deals/en-us/US/hotels-in-united-states.ssp): Browse hotel deals across cities and regions in the United States.
- [Hotels in Las Vegas](https://www.priceline.com/hotel-deals/en-us/P3000035826/hotels-in-las-vegas-nevada.ssp): Find hotel deals for Las Vegas stays.
- [Hotels in New York City](https://www.priceline.com/hotel-deals/en-us/P3000035825/hotels-in-new-york-city-new-york.ssp): Compare hotel options and prices in New York City.
- [Hotels in Orlando](https://www.priceline.com/hotel-deals/en-us/P3000035824/hotels-in-orlando-florida.ssp): Search discounted hotels for Orlando travel.

## Flights
- [Cheap Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights): Search one-way, round-trip, and multi-city airfare options.
- [Round Trip Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights/round-trip): Compare round-trip flight prices across airlines and dates.
- [One Way Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights/one-way): Search one-way airfare for flexible travel planning.
- [Multi City Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights/multi-city): Book itineraries with multiple flight segments in one search.
- [Last Minute Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights/last-minute): Explore flight options for near-term departures.
- [International Flights](https://www.priceline.com/flights/international): Search airfare for international routes and destinations.

## Cars and Ground Travel
- [Rental Cars](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars): Compare car rental inventory, pricing, and pickup locations.
- [Airport Car Rentals](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars/airport): Find rental cars near major airport locations.
- [One Way Car Rentals](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars/one-way): Search rentals with different pickup and drop-off locations.
- [Luxury Car Rentals](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars/luxury): Browse premium and luxury rental vehicle options.
- [SUV Rentals](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars/suv): Compare SUV rental availability and pricing.
- [Van Rentals](https://www.priceline.com/rental-cars/van): Find passenger van rentals for larger groups.

## Packages and Vacation Planning
- [Vacation Packages](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages): Search bundled hotel and flight deals for trips.
- [All Inclusive Vacations](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages/all-inclusive): Explore package options with all-inclusive resort stays.
- [Family Vacations](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages/family): Browse vacation packages suited for family travel.
- [Beach Vacations](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages/beach): Find package deals for beach destinations.
- [Last Minute Vacations](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages/last-minute): Search package deals for upcoming travel dates.
- [Weekend Getaways](https://www.priceline.com/vacation-packages/weekend-getaways): Discover short-trip package options for quick escapes.

## Deals and Savings
- [Express Deals](https://www.priceline.com/express-deals): Access discounted opaque offers across travel categories.
- [Tonight Only Deals](https://www.priceline.com/tonight-only): Find same-day hotel discounts and limited-time offers.
- [Featured Deals](https://www.priceline.com/deals): Browse current promotions and travel savings opportunities.
- [Hotel Coupons and Promo Codes](https://www.priceline.com/deals/hotels): View hotel-related deals and promotional offers.
- [Flight Deals](https://www.priceline.com/deals/flights): Explore airfare promotions and discounted routes.
- [Car Rental Deals](https://www.priceline.com/deals/rental-cars): Find current savings on rental car bookings.

## Trips and Account
- [Trip Lookup](https://www.priceline.com/next-profile/trip-lookup): Retrieve and manage existing bookings using trip details.
- [My Trips](https://www.priceline.com/mytrips): Access upcoming and past reservations in one place.
- [Sign In](https://www.priceline.com/login): Log in to manage bookings, profile details, and preferences.
- [Create Account](https://www.priceline.com/register): Register for a Priceline account to save traveler information.
- [Profile](https://www.priceline.com/next-profile): Manage account settings and personal travel details.
- [Priceline VIP](https://www.priceline.com/vip): Learn about member savings and loyalty-style benefits.

## Customer Support
- [Customer Service](https://www.priceline.com/help): Access support resources for bookings, changes, and cancellations.
- [Help Center](https://www.priceline.com/help-center): Browse answers to common travel and account questions.
- [Contact Us](https://www.priceline.com/help/contact-us): Find ways to contact Priceline support.
- [Cancellation Policy Help](https://www.priceline.com/help/cancellations): Review cancellation and refund guidance for bookings.
- [Change Reservation Help](https://www.priceline.com/help/changes): Learn how to modify eligible reservations.
- [Travel Alerts](https://www.priceline.com/help/travel-alerts): Check important notices affecting travel plans and bookings.

- [About Priceline](https://www.priceline.com/about): Learn about Priceline and its travel booking services.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.priceline.com/static-pages/terms-and-conditions): Review booking terms and site usage policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.priceline.com/static-pages/privacy-policy): Read how Priceline collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.priceline.com/static-pages/cookie-policy): Understand cookie usage and related choices on the site.
- [Careers](https://www.priceline.com/careers): Explore employment opportunities and company information.
- [Press](https://www.priceline.com/press): Access company news and media resources.
